goal: Den Zahlenbereich als naechsten Regeltyp deterministisch planen und den kleinsten spaeteren browserlokalen Preview-Slice abgrenzen.

guide_delta.summary: I171 erklaert eine Zahlenbereichsregel als rein temporaere Pruefung einer Unter- oder Obergrenze; weder Regel noch Testwert oder vorhandene Daten werden gespeichert.

direct_dependencies: I170 browser-test exception is not reusable
tests_explicitly_not_run: product tests because runtime is unchanged
UI and Chromium tests because rendering is unchanged
storage tests because repository and schema are unchanged
full suite because this is a local contract-only change
risks: the planning contract could be mistaken for runtime approval
locale-dependent parsing could make later evaluation nondeterministic
both bounds or productive activation could accidentally expand the first implementation slice
non_changes: no number-range preview implementation or activation
no TODO or roadmap progress change
no persistence, validation_json or schema change
expected_side_effects: number-range semantics and failure states become reviewable before implementation
the next safe implementation slice is limited to one browser-local draft number field and one bound
